title: Finance Business Partner Specialty Care for Intercontinental

cond_0001.intro: The primary objective of this position is to provide financial leadership for the Intercontinental Management Team, overseeing $2bn+ revenue in Specialty Care ([Product name masked], Eye Care, Neuroscience & Specialty) Business Units. Specifically, this position is responsible for all brand related financial reporting and analysis to Plan, Update, LBE and LRP cycles, decision-making support and recommendations to the Intercontinental AREA Finance Director and Specialty Care Commercial Director, taking into consideration business dynamics and resourcing. In addition, this position is responsible for ensuring the business support of cross portfolio initiatives, profitability analysis and project management.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Financial Business Partner - Lead the planning processes for Specialty Care and synthesize Intercontinental portfolio story for IMCO and Corporate reviews, while ensuring accurate and timely integration of sales forecast, pricing, and investment resourcing to all brands.
Ensure financial planning deliverables are accurate, clear, and concise for Executive level review and approvals.
Work closely with the Associate Finance Director to ensure adequate and appropriate resourcing levels. Drive dedicated R&D / SG&A for Specialty Care.
Provide financial analysis, monthly sales reports, reviewing affiliates demand forecast and deliver insights that link financial reports to business strategy for the Intercon S&OP.
Work closely with IMCO brand finance partners to develop models that accurately incorporate market dynamics including market share and market growth. Assure consistency across brands in financial templates, deliverables, and key analysis.
Management of all reporting activities including but not limited to: LBEs, PLN, LRP, Monthly Sales, Budgeting monitoring.
Decision Support/Special Projects -- Provide analyses for ad hoc or other business presentations that lend insight into key business drivers enabling operating management to adapt more appropriate tactics/strategy to meet the LRP objectives.
Management of cross portfolio initiatives and support IMCO and Global functions on their brand financial requirements (including Commercial Models, Marketing analytics).
Significant Work Activities - Continuous sitting for prolonged periods (more than 2 consecutive hours in an 8 hour day)
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance.
7-10 Years progressive accounting or finance experience.
Ability to proactively search out and evaluate business problems and opportunities.
Ability to solve business problems through the proactive identification of issues and subsequent collection, analysis, and interpretation of related data.
Preferred Requirements
Prior experience collaborating with commercial teams and business partner mindset.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills / fully fluent in English.
Strong interpersonal, and teamwork skills.
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0601.intro: The primary objective of this position is to provide financial leadership for the Intercontinental Management Team, overseeing $2bn+ revenue in Specialty Care ([Product name masked], Eye Care, Neuroscience & Specialty) Business Units. This position is responsible for all brand-related financial reporting and analysis across Plan, Update, LBE and LRP cycles, decision-making support and recommendations to the Intercontinental AREA Finance Director and Specialty Care Commercial Director, taking into consideration business dynamics and resourcing. In addition, this position is responsible for ensuring business support of cross portfolio initiatives, profitability analysis and project management.
cond_0601.responsibilities:
Financial Business Partner – Lead the planning processes for Specialty Care and synthesize the Intercontinental portfolio story for IMCO and Corporate reviews, ensuring accurate and timely integration of sales forecast, pricing, and investment resourcing to all brands.
Ensure financial planning deliverables are accurate, clear, and concise for Executive level review and approvals.
Coordinate with the Associate Finance Director to ensure adequate and appropriate resourcing levels. Drive dedicated R&D / SG&A for Specialty Care.
Prepare financial analysis and monthly sales reports, review affiliates demand forecast, and deliver insights that link financial reports to business strategy for the Intercon S&OP.
Coordinate with IMCO brand finance partners to develop models that accurately incorporate market dynamics including market share and market growth. Ensure consistency across brands in financial templates, deliverables, and key analysis.
Manage all reporting activities including but not limited to: LBEs, PLN, LRP, Monthly Sales, Budgeting monitoring.
Decision Support/Special Projects – Provide analyses for ad hoc or other business presentations that give insight into key business drivers, enabling operating management to adapt tactics and strategy to meet LRP objectives.
Manage cross portfolio initiatives and support IMCO and Global functions on their brand financial requirements (including Commercial Models, Marketing analytics).
Significant Work Activities – Continuous sitting for prolonged periods (more than 2 consecutive hours in an 8 hour day).
cond_0601.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance
7–10 Years of progressive accounting or finance experience
Ability to identify business problems and opportunities and evaluate them through data collection, analysis, and interpretation
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting skills, fully fluent in English
Preferred Requirements
Prior experience working with commercial teams and a business partner mindset
Strong interpersonal and teamwork skills
